newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Dorchester buys Knightsbridge motor finance.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Dorchester buys Knightsbridge motor finance.

text.p: Dorchester Pacific Ltd said on Wednesday it had bought Wellington-based motor vehicle finance company Knightsbridge Finance Ltd for $1 million cash plus the financing of Knightsbridge's $2.5 million loan book.
The deal was made through Dorchester subsidiary Senate Holdings, which last month also bought Bridge Personnel and Management Consultants, now trading as Dorchester Personnel.
Dorchester said the Knightsbridge buy would strengthen its position in the used motor vehicle finance sector.
It said Dorchester Finances fixed interest investment products continued to attract pleasing support.

The recently issued Subordinated Unsecured Notes were proving particularly popular. The value of the notes issued already exceeded $2 million, while the company's Secured Debenture Stock had attracted total investments of close to $30
Dorchester Finance activities were showing a very sound return on equity.

The company said directors were continuing to look for further opportunities and investments in areas compatible with the Group's interests in the finance, recruitment and immigration sectors. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
